correctness.rationale: The root-coordinate graph-potential count fixes one of three left potentials and gives 6r left pairs with spread r>0, hence L_q(t)=(2t+1)^q+6Σ_{r=1}^{2t}r(2t+1-r)^q. The finite magic-basis inversion and two Bernoulli formulas are derived from that polynomial; q mod 4 with Euler-Bernoulli inequalities covers all q>=13, and six exact negative rational witnesses cover q=7..12. Positive complete vectors cover q=1..6. No extrapolation from finite tests is used.
